name: Turn-of-the-candle effect in bitcoin returns (15-minute candle turns)
instrument: [uncertain] BTC/USD on crypto exchanges (Bitfinex, Bittrex, Binance, Gemini, Kucoin, Bitstamp, FTX); mapping to Maven MT5 BTCUSD CFD not verified
timeframe: 1-minute bars; effect measured at quarter-hour candle turns (minutes 0, 15, 30, 45 of each hour)
entry_rule: [uncertain] Paper tests a dummy D_t = 1 at minutes 0/15/30/45 vs. all other minutes. Implied trade: buy at the close of the minute before a quarter-hour turn. Paper does not state an explicit trading rule for this step.
exit_rule: [uncertain] Implied: sell at the close of the turn minute (1-2 minute hold). Not stated in source.
stop_rule: [uncertain] No stop described in source. Typical distance not determined.
holding_time: [uncertain] About 1-2 minutes if the implied rule is used.
trades_per_year: [uncertain] Up to about 35,000 candidate turns per year (4 per hour, 24/7). Actual count depends on any filter, which the source does not specify.
overnight_weekend: [uncertain] Crypto trades 24/7 so the rule would span nights and weekends. Source does not discuss weekend handling.
signal_window_definition: Quarter-hour candle turns (minutes 0, 15, 30, 45). Source does not state the time zone of 'trading hour'. Exchange clocks are UTC-based and have no DST. Maven/FundedNext broker server time may follow DST and must be mapped [uncertain].
sample_period: 1-minute data per exchange from each first available month (Bitfinex from April 2013; FTX from January 2020), ending 31 December 2021
out_of_sample: Limited out-of-sample test: January to August 2022 on Bitfinex. OLS coefficient 0.2916 (significant at 1%); conditional-median coefficient 0.1126 (significant at 1%). No 2023 or later test in source.
cost_assumption: Exchange fee schedules, including a 10 bps new-account fee on Bitfinex and 30-day volume discounts. Panel B adds Bitfinex bid-ask spreads from data.bitcoinity.org. No CFD spread, swap or broker commission modeled.
reported_metrics: Average turn-of-candle return 0.58 bps per minute (Bitfinex, 2021; range 0.55 to 0.66 across exchanges). Full-sample OLS kappa: Bitfinex 0.2500, Binance 0.3804, FTX 0.5798 (all significant at 1%). 2021 OLS kappa Bitfinex 0.9024. Simulated 2021 Bitfinex strategy from USD 5,000: 74.18% net vs. 60.27% buy-and-hold; probabilistic Sharpe 4.9635 vs. 0.7681 for buy-and-hold (Z = 9.78).
third_party_replication: [uncertain] No independent replication found in this session. The paper itself replicates the effect across 7 exchanges.
decay_status: Regime-dependent, possibly weakening. Effect first appears in 2017 (Bitfinex, Gemini); Chow tests place a structural shift in mid-to-late 2020; 2021 coefficients (0.82-0.97) are much larger than the full-sample ones (0.25-0.58); 2022 out-of-sample coefficient is 0.29. No post-2022 data in source.
regime_split: Yes. Full sample 0.25-0.58; 2021 only 0.82-0.97; post-shift 2020-2021 dominates; out-of-sample Jan-Aug 2022 on Bitfinex 0.29. No 2023+ split available.
data_source_requirement: 1-minute BTC OHLC bars. Maven MT5 BTCUSD M1 history availability [uncertain]. No funding-rate, options or tick data needed for this rule.
min_lot_fit_5k10k: [uncertain] Not computable from source. Formula: risk % = (lot contract size x price x stop distance) / account equity. Source defines no stop and Maven BTCUSD contract size is not verified.
fn_rule_fit: [uncertain] Not verified against FundedNext rules. A strategy that trades every quarter-hour may be classed as high-frequency or tick-scalping and must be checked against the policy. The +-5 min news rule may cover many turns on macro days.
bot_policy_compliance: [uncertain] Executable by bot on clock timestamps with no messaging link needed. FundedNext bot policy not verified in this session.
event_overlap: Turns at minute 00 coincide with hourly macro releases (often at :00 or :30 ET) and with 00/08/16 UTC funding settlements on the hour. Overlap is frequent; exact count not computed.
overlap_with_existing: [uncertain] Partial overlap with the BTC 21-23 UTC module: that 2-hour window contains 8 quarter-hour turns per day. Overlap with Donchian XAU is none (different instrument). Share of trades overlapping is not computed.
rejected_catalog_hit: [uncertain] Not checked. Main session must run python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol with terms such as 'turn of candle', 'intraday seasonality' and 'BTC'.
base_rate_check: [uncertain] Claim is a gross return premium of about 0.58 bps per minute at turns. Base rate for random 1-minute bars is near zero, so the test must compare turn minutes against matched non-turn minutes. The paper does this, but the 0.58 bps gross figure is smaller than typical retail CFD spreads and must be measured on Maven per the project cost rule.
pitfall_risk: Post-hoc discovery on in-sample data; peak year 2021 suggests regime dependence; gross edge (0.58 bps per minute) may fall below Maven CFD spread and commission; very high trade count amplifies cost sensitivity; small-sample out-of-sample only on one exchange.
notes: Candidate 2 (rejected for this task): He, Manela, Ross, von Wachter, 'Fundamentals of Perpetual Futures', arXiv 2212.06888 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.06888). Theory of perpetual pricing and funding-rate arbitrage; funding paid every 8 hours and approximates the average futures-spot gap over the prior 8 hours. The arXiv abstract page shows v7 revised 17 Sep 2026. No intraday, settlement-window or weekend return test was found in the abstract or search snippets. The strategy needs perpetual and spot legs, so it is not implementable on a single BTCUSD CFD.

Candidate 3: Quantpedia, 'How To Profitably Trade Bitcoin's Overnight Sessions?' (https://quantpedia.com/how-to-profitably-trade-bitcoins-overnight-sessions/). Vendor blog, not peer-reviewed. Hourly Gemini BTC data 2015-10-08 to 2024-10-15; in-sample to Oct 2021, out-of-sample after Oct 2021. Final MAX(10) strategy holds Friday close to Monday open and includes weekend holding. Text reports 'over 35% performance with a minimal -12% maximal drawdown'; exact Sharpe is only in images. No transaction costs stated. Relevant to the BTC weekend question, but it is a daily overnight rule, not 1-2 minute.

Candidate 4: Liu, Chen-Han (2024), 'Exploring Calendar Effects in Bitcoin Returns: An Analysis of Market Efficiency', Journal of Applied Finance & Banking, vol. 14 issue 4 (https://ideas.repec.org/a/spt/apfiba/v14y2024i4f14_4_3.html). Data Oct 2015 to Nov 2021; regression and power-ratio tests for day-of-week and intraday effects. Conclusion: effects not pervasive enough to overturn efficiency. Friday-specific claim could not be confirmed from abstract. Sample ends before 2023.

Candidate 5: AristoQuant, 'Bitcoin weekdays and weekends analysis' (Medium, Oct 2023, https://medium.com/@aristoquant/bitcoin-weekdays-and-weekends-analysis-00e3aec0ae95). Blog analysis: weekday cumulative returns exceed weekend returns, Sunday weakest, gap narrowing in later bull markets. Conflicts in sign with the Quantpedia Friday-to-Monday finding; sample and method not verified.

Candidate 6: Cardiff University paper on NYSE sessions leading Bitcoin activity (https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/151082/1/1-s2.0-S1544612322003269-main.pdf). Published 2022, outside 2023+ window. Effects weaken at weekends. Mechanism-level only.

Funding-settlement evidence gap: a search surfaced a high-frequency study (2017-2023 order-book data) linking spot-market informed trading and spread widening to funding settlement hours, with the effect larger when funding fees are larger. It is a liquidity result, not a return drift around the 8-hour timestamps. Title and authors not extracted. No replicable return rule around funding timestamps was found.

Overlap caveat: the 8-hour funding timestamps (00, 08, 16 UTC) fall on quarter-hour turns, so any turn-based rule and any funding-timed rule are not independent samples. Count overlapping bars before counting them as separate observations.

Gap: no 2023+ out-of-sample evidence for a 1-2 minute turn rule was found. The only out-of-sample period (Jan-Aug 2022) ends before the 2023 window requested. Recommend measuring Maven BTCUSD spread with reality_profiler before any pre-registration.
